items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: You have to ask Pete, see. Pete and Manny Manetta, see they can tell you more about it. Because I was a kid, I couldn't go down in the district.

ctx.x: I was a real boy. You say you played every, what, what's the room?

Every Christmas night we played at the St. Charles Hotel for years. Who was that called? I never know the name of the club, it was some big rich club. But we would start playing from around November the 1st. We would play the introduction nearly to all the debutants at different places, you know. And we'd be playing every night spot job different places from about November the 1st until Mardi Gras night. Mardi Gras day, we'd play at the Boston club, the same job that Celestine had. Mardi Gras day and Mardi Gras…
You say you got Mardi Gras day? Mardi Gras day?
